summary: Resubmitted the validated review of artifact e6f6940adbc9419f91e49143c34d1a84, the second scenario of obligation c-adopted-term-never-regresses using the production TCP transport. The two earlier attempts were rejected only because the final-response text was not parseable JSON (first a code-fenced block, then a prose preamble before the JSON), not for any content defect; the harness captures only the last assistant message, so the answer is now emitted as bare JSON. Preflight returns valid:true with no diagnostics, and every referenced id resolves: artifact e6f6940adbc9419f91e49143c34d1a84, checks aeb40d35bddd4b2aabdc0491c3fde500 and 78e4fd0d22b74afbbe4de6c6a912156d, and inherited issue 9bb534c3914b40c79ce849c715918da5. The product carries: (1) a checker_correspondence no_issue_found item covering requirement-vs-predicate, entry and caller duties, oracle, identity, legal history and completion for the reviewed execution; (2) an applicability no_issue_found item establishing that the term-context duty binds the shipped NetworkTransport rather than only the substitute stream layer; and (3) a resolution of issue 9bb534c3914b40c79ce849c715918da5 disposing condition c-adopted-term-never-regresses/grounding/condition/1 as independent_scope. Retained observation: the node reported adopting term 6 while the effective term context afterwards was 5, injected store write sequence 0,1,1,5,6, transport reported tcp on 127.0.0.1:42919, test exit 0. Explicit limitations retained: latency-free loopback, skip-on-bind-failure falls back to the substitute-layer record, the equality encoding coincides with not-lower-than-the-admitted-term only inside the two-write prefix, and transport is the only varied input. This resolution clears the open issue that held unit-c-adopted-term-never-regresses at partial; the remaining frontier stays open and untouched by this turn: a map refresh to close the answered TCP scheduling unknown on b-heartbeat-fastpath, lease-relation width, repair-layer choices for the client-future and term/lease defects, and the deferred surfaces (installSnapshot commit context, MonotonicLogStore, third-party SetHeartbeatHandler callers, nested fuzzy and raft-compat modules).
